meta.title: JarvisMind Memory
meta.description: Automatic cross-session memory recall and capture, an always-on soul/relationship anchor, and explicit search, remember and forget tools, backed by a local JarvisMind server.

baseUrl.title: Server URL
baseUrl.description: Root of the local JarvisMind server, for example http://127.0.0.1:8777.

tokenEnv.title: Token environment variable
tokenEnv.description: Environment variable read before the token file.

tokenFile.title: Token file
tokenFile.description: Fallback file containing the agent token. ~ is expanded.

autoRecall.title: Automatic recall
autoRecall.description: Inject relevant long-term memories into the system prompt before each step.

recallLimit.title: Recall limit
recallLimit.description: Maximum number of memories retrieved for one message (1-20).

autoRemember.title: Automatic capture
autoRemember.description: Allow memories to be submitted automatically. Turn this off to keep JarvisMind read-only.

rememberMode.title: Who decides what to remember
rememberMode.description: agent: the model decides and calls the remember tool, so noise such as acknowledgements is never stored (recommended). auto: every user turn is submitted. both: the model decides and every turn is also submitted.

enum.both: The model decides, and every turn too

memoryStyle.title: Memory style
memoryStyle.description: assistant: focused on preferences, decisions, habits and important dates. companion: also notices shared jokes, significant events, emotional turns and what the two of you agreed.

coreAnchorEnabled.title: Soul continuity anchor
coreAnchorEnabled.description: Keep an always-on block of the user's defining memories in the prompt, so a compaction or a new session does not lose how they want to be addressed.

coreAnchorLimit.title: Anchor memories
coreAnchorLimit.description: Maximum number of memories kept in the anchor (1-12).

coreAnchorMaxChars.title: Anchor characters per memory
coreAnchorMaxChars.description: Maximum characters kept per anchor memory (100-2000). Longer memories are truncated so one entry cannot fill the window.

timeoutMs.title: Request timeout
timeoutMs.description: Upper bound for one JarvisMind request, in milliseconds. A timeout never blocks the conversation.
